name: google-cast-sdk
summary: Framework for casting content to Google Cast devices (DYNAMIC build).
description: Local override of the trunk google-cast-sdk pod. The trunk 4.8.x podspec vends the STATIC GoogleCast.framework (an ar archive with static_framework: true), which is never embedded into the app bundle. Shift72RocketSDK.framework (shipped by rocket-expo) has a hard LC_LOAD_DYLIB on @rpath/GoogleCast.framework/GoogleCast and therefore needs a DYNAMIC GoogleCast.framework embedded at runtime. This override points at Google's official _dynamic distribution of the exact same version so the framework gets embedded and the dyld dependency is satisfied.
